title: Chapter 7037: Nine Maternal Powers

Chapter 7037: Nine Maternal Powers

Chapter 7037: Nine Maternal Powers

“Seems like it’s happening soon and you are certain of victory.” He said.

“Who else is in line?” Li Qiye asked.

He took a good look at Li Qiye and said: “No one, maybe Octopus’ group. Heavenfall has no chance since he has not let go. It’s only An Ran.”

“Can kill all in one go.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Are you still human?” He remarked.

“I am a human, a mortal, unlike you all.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I suppose you’re right when we’re talking about the mortal world.” He agreed: “Just a mortal, I see. I don’t know how you did it, it’s unprecedented.”

“Unprecedented no longer.” Li Qiye said.

“Right, you can say whatever you want since you’re the strongest.” He scratched his head: “Nonetheless, there are two things you need to pay attention to.”

“Two things?” Li Qiye said.

“First, the maternal power. It is there in every world, and one can’t threaten you. However, all of them combined might be a different story. For example, this world should be, hmm, core of something...”

“Core of Order.” Li Qiye said.

“That’s the name, it’s right in this world. Hidden Immortal told me before but I couldn’t remember. Where did you hear it from?” He asked.

“Calculated with my fingers.” Li Qiye smiled.

“As if I don’t know how to play with my fingers. I would have known long ago.” He said with disdain.

“Core of Order, World’s Heart, Nest of Life, Source of Wisdom, these are the maternal powers you speak of.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I’ve never heard of these before.” He was surprised.

“This is why it is easy to become immortals in the nine major worlds, they are blessed with these cores.” Li Qiye said.

“They’re impressive indeed.” He murmured: “What will happen if all nine are combined?”

“Hard to say, it’s difficult to combine them and would be another unprecedented feat.” Li Qiye said.

“Are you trying to?” He stared at Li Qiye who only sipped his drink and didn’t answer.

“How did you know?” He didn’t give up.

“I felt it when I saved the near-death World’s Heart.” Li Qiye said.

“So that’s where the secret lies, no wonder I couldn’t find it.” He murmured.

“Because all of you never cared. Stygian dying was one thing, but you all changed a perfectly fine world into Heaven Pit. That’s why you never felt the world’s power.” Li Qiye said.

“Hahaha, Devouring Alliance had control over Stygian, we couldn’t have done anything.” He said.

“So Mang could have beaten you?” Li Qiye asked.

“Bah, the little bastard? What a joke, I would have crushed him.” He said.

“Either way, this is the truth. All of you never cared about worlds since they could be destroyed by Mang, you, or the villainous heaven.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, the villainous heaven will destroy them eventually.” He said.

In the past, Devouring Alliance was certainly strong. However, celestial immortals could have defeated them. After all, they schemed even against the high heaven.

Alas, Mang was smart not to provoke them. There were still eight more worlds.

“In reality, the high heaven’s destruction and your destruction are two entirely different matters. You all know this but didn’t care enough due to not losing anything personally.” Li Qiye said.

“Sir, I promised I was too lazy to worry about those devouring insects and never researched more about Stygian.” He raised his hand.

“You claimed to love this world yet have done nothing for it. Immortals are just unnecessary.” Li Qiye said.

“...” He had no response.

“If I have to bet, I would say that as long as no one touches your parents’ world, you wouldn’t care about the destruction of the rest.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Not to that extent.” He smiled wryly: “The nine major worlds are boundless, no one can protect all of them.”

“Yes, but immortals actively seek to destroy.” Li Qiye said.
